options.name: deadtime
options.description: Duration for which a non-reachable AAA server is skipped, in minutes or keyword 'default. Range is 1-1440. Device default is 0.

options.name: directed_request
options.description: Enables direct authentication requests to AAA server or keyword 'default' Device default is disabled.

options.name: encrypt_type
options.description: The state of encryption applied to the entered global key. O clear text, 7 encrypted. Type-6 encryption is not supported.

options.name: global_key
options.description: Global AAA shared secret or keyword 'default'.

options.name: server_timeout
options.description: Global AAA server timeout period, in seconds or keyword 'default. Range is 1-60. Device default is 5.

options.name: server_type
options.description: The server type is either radius or tacacs.

options.name: state
options.description: Manage the state of the resource.
